# Webhook Automation Service v0.10.3

This patch release makes the Receiver schema reflect the authenticated project's actual write permissions. Owners and members retain create/delete capabilities; restricted and read-only roles receive read-only Receiver methods, matching the existing API enforcement. Schema responses are private and non-cacheable so a writable capability response cannot be reused for another role.

The change covers both `/v1-webhooks/schemas` and `/v1-webhooks/schemas/receiver` without changing Receiver data, credentials, routes, or project isolation. Regression tests check both endpoints, mixed roles, and concurrent requests against a shared schema.

The release source is merged commit `fbcc0ca07e42e9b21bda18031d0848192ec2f9a1`.
The Linux archive SHA-256 is
`6babbc18cee9a192009cfadcd143e6b9a5f2b550c4dc419781f3e3657caa022a`.
The merged-commit [security release gate](https://github.com/PastureStack/webhook-automation-service/actions/runs/36298986720) passed, including integration and race tests, deterministic packaging, vulnerability analysis, and source/artifact scans. Server 8080 UI acceptance is a separate integration gate.
